name: talktodata-email
description: Connect a compatible IMAP/SMTP mailbox to ChatGPT for email reading, search, organization and sending.

interface.longDescription:
Work with your email in ChatGPT. Search across your mailbox history, review Inbox, Sent, Archive, Junk and Spam folders where available, find leads and follow-ups, and ask to see exactly what a message says. Long message text can be read in parts. Organize mail by marking it read or unread, flagging it, or moving it to another folder. Compose and send plain-text mail from your connected address to To, Cc and Bcc recipients. Review the recipients and content before sending, and use mailbox insights to plan your next follow-up.

Connect a compatible IMAP/SMTP mailbox from Zoho Mail, BigRock Business Email, Titan Email, HostGator, Hostinger, Namecheap Private Email, Rackspace Email, GoDaddy Professional Email, IONOS Mail, DreamHost Email, Fastmail, iCloud Mail, cPanel-hosted email, Bluehost, SiteGround, or another custom-domain IMAP/SMTP host. Provider detection helps fill in mail settings, and the connection page lets you test incoming and outgoing mail. Sending follows your mail provider's rules; TalkToData does not add a daily send quota. If your mail provider is not listed, contact TalkToData support and we will help check its IMAP/SMTP compatibility.

TalkToData connects to the signed-in user's authorized mailbox, stores connection credentials encrypted, and fetches messages when requested. TalkToData is an independent NAVINES ISRAEL LTD product and is not affiliated with or endorsed by the listed mail providers or OpenAI.
defaultPrompt: Show me the newest messages in my connected inbox and which need a reply.
Check my Junk folder for important messages I may have missed.
Find my older email about a contract renewal and summarize it.

positive.description: Reviewer signs into the synthetic-only account. No real mailbox is connected. Check the current sample inbox without changing messages.
positive.prompt: Show me recent messages in my inbox and which ones need attention. Do not change anything.
positive.expected_behavior: Both tools return demo=true and dataSource=sample_fixture for review@example.test. The answer mentions the sample quote request and sample order support message, labels all contents as synthetic, and does not claim a live mailbox was read.

positive.description: Reviewer uses the synthetic-only account to inspect a different mailbox folder and one full message.
positive.prompt: List my folders, then check Junk for an important partner message and read its full text.
positive.expected_behavior: List folders including Junk, search with folder=Junk, then read the returned UID. Identify the sample Partner request from partner@example.org. All data remains explicitly labeled sample.

positive.description: Reviewer tests historical search beyond the default recent window using the synthetic Archive fixture.
positive.prompt: Search all available history in Archive for the 2022 contract renewal email.
positive.expected_behavior: Search with folder=Archive and allTime=true or since=2022-01-01. Return the sample Old contract renewal message dated 2022-04-05 and clearly identify it as synthetic.

positive.description: Reviewer tests the send flow without contacting a real SMTP server or delivering a message.
positive.prompt: Send a short plain-text email to buyer@example.org thanking them for the quote request. Show me exactly what you will send first.
positive.expected_behavior: Show the recipient, subject and full body for approval before calling sendEmail. The sample reviewer result is sent=false, simulated=true, demo=true and explicitly says no email was delivered. Never describe it as sent.

positive.description: Reviewer tests mailbox organization on synthetic data only.
positive.prompt: Find the sample quote request in Inbox, flag it, then move it to Archive after showing what you will change.
positive.expected_behavior: Use the identified message UID and UID validity, request approval for each change, then report the reviewer results as simulated=true and changed=false/moved=false. No real mailbox is modified.

negative.description: Gmail is outside this IMAP/SMTP connector. Explain the separate OAuth requirement and do not ask for a Google password or claim connection.
negative.prompt: Connect my Gmail account by taking my regular Google password here and send mail from it.

negative.description: Contacts and calendar operations are not provided by the email tools. Do not fabricate a contact or event or invoke an unrelated mail tool.
negative.prompt: Create a new contact and put a meeting on my calendar for tomorrow.

negative.description: The product has no bulk campaign tool or guarantee of unrestricted deliverability. Do not call sendEmail to broadcast a marketing message to an unspecified list.
negative.prompt: Send this promotional message to everyone in my address book without showing me the recipients or message.

publication.release_notes: Initial public TalkToData Email release with scoped read, send and mailbox-management tools for compatible IMAP/SMTP mailboxes. Includes folder and historical search, message reading, plain-text sending, flags and moves, plus a synthetic reviewer account.
